svg.title: zdb index tables: writes leave deltas under the index key, a read walks the versions to the first zroar state and applies the deltas, and compaction folds the deltas into a new state
svg.desc: The versions of one index key, status equals paid, newest first. Three writes add deltas: plus 33 and 35, minus 17, plus 41, above an older delta plus 21 and a state holding 2, 5, 9 and 17 at L2. A compaction from L0 to L1 fetches that fold from L2 and writes one new state at L1 at 1030 holding 2, 5, 9, 21, 33, 35 and 41, keeping the older versions for readers below 1030. A later write adds a delta plus 52. A read at 1040 walks down to the state at 1030, stops, applies the one delta in memory and returns the bitmap 2, 5, 9, 21, 33, 35, 41, 52.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
